environment.dependencies: stdlib plus optional pinned tokenizers only

lexical.unit: Unicode word run, whitespace run, or single punctuation/symbol

methodology.topology: public fixed single-predicate core-v0.1; no conditionals or length prediction
methodology.correlated_world: 18 uniform latent states (subject_index s,relation_index r,tense_index t): object=1-s; polarity=(s+r)%2; aspect=t; evidence=(s+r+t)%4
methodology.posterior: Exact finite-support posterior for every observation. Bernoulli token mask likelihood is constant for matching equal-length candidates.
methodology.mask_expectations: Surface interiors stratify over all meanings and sample masks; endpoints, semantic masks, length information and completion distributions are exact. Mask SE excludes corpus/prior uncertainty.
methodology.length_leakage: Gold-length conditions reveal target token count. Fixed-canvas controls pad to the public maximum; visible padding still conveys information, but full erasure cannot reveal target length.
methodology.completion: Round groups are static schedules, not optimal neural denoising. Each round independently samples exact marginals given prior sampled commitments. Invalid prefixes fail. All target probabilities computed by enumeration, without revealing source gold.
methodology.adaptive_completion: Greedy exact joint-independence checks choose parallel groups in forward/reverse order, conditioning on sampled commitments each round. All remaining deterministic positions can be predicted together on the next round. Exact support/fidelity, greedy rather than optimal round counts.
methodology.recoverability_vs_completion: Further self-generated commitments add no evidence about the hidden original. Refinement can improve support/TV, never exceed the observation's Bayes original-recovery ceiling. Exact joint posterior sampling is a separate 1-round oracle.
methodology.work_proxies: K*N and K*N^2 assume full canvas processing every pass; no model, vocabulary projection, decoder, hardware, or validation cost is measured.
methodology.limits: Tiny known priors, fixed public topology, two ASCII labels, no learning/generalization claims. Neither oracle rounds nor CPU runtime predict Mercury/GPU refinement steps or latency.

methodology.probabilities: Exact Fraction enumeration; entropy and exported metrics use float.
methodology.prior: Uniform over the explicitly listed semantic world states.
methodology.masking: Independent Bernoulli erasure of atomic synthetic slots; observed slots are correct.
methodology.tokenization: Synthetic atomic slots, not Sylang/English/JSON text tokenizer counts.
methodology.recovery: Bayes maximum posterior probability of recovering the original hidden world.
methodology.fidelity: TV and valid support compare sampled outputs with the exact conditional distribution.
methodology.refinement: Condition on sampled commitments; no hidden-gold reveal. Parallel slots sample independently.
methodology.optimality_scope: Minimum worst-case rounds within exact posterior-independent group policies; not a bound for all diffusion algorithms.
methodology.threshold_aggregation: Primary threshold averages over source worlds and masks; worst-observation threshold is also reported.
methodology.budget_rule: Final allowed round fills remaining slots independently; prior rounds commit an optimal independent subset.
methodology.cost_proxy: Fixed synthetic canvas slots times executed rounds (or squared slots); excludes network/heads/packing/decoder costs.
methodology.limits: Tiny known priors; no learned model, training, speed timing, remasking, or unequal-slot output-head cost.

worlds.name: independent_bits
worlds.description: Two independent fair bits; no dependency benefit is available.

worlds.name: correlated_pair
worlds.description: Two fields repeat the same fair bit.

worlds.name: two_correlated_pairs
worlds.description: Two independent latent bits, each repeated in two fields.

worlds.name: even_parity
worlds.description: Three fields have even parity; every pair is marginally independent.
